title: D3K on a passed ball: batter reaches first, strikeout credited, no error

expect.note: A passed ball is not an error (§13.2) — the two are separate statistics, and the rulebook charges a batter reaching on a passed ball or wild pitch on strike three to nobody's glove. The catcher's drop is still recorded as a misplay: layer 1 is physics and does not depend on what official scoring makes of it. Contrast play-05, where the catcher's *throw* to first sails and E2 throwing is charged — a thrown ball is not a pitch.
